method.corpusDescription: 32 fixed, self-authored everyday/software sentences per language; 8 paragraphs formed by joining consecutive groups of 4 sentences.
method.coldRequest: Fresh server process, prepared model files, no model download/conversion or OS page-cache eviction.
method.memory: Linux VmHWM for the entire server process (including model loading); one fresh process per language pair.
method.backgroundLoad: Shared desktop machine; other applications and compute tasks were left running.
